title: Find the fengycin locus in two more Bacillus velezensis genomes
summary: Select the fengycin locus of B. velezensis FZB42, find it in a complete genome and a draft assembly with Find in other files, and draw the windows as a new drawing: similarity groups, genes colored by function, and gene names on the reference row.

downloads.label: NC_009725.2
downloads.note: Download the record as a GenBank flat file.

downloads.label: NZ_CP011937.1
downloads.note: Download the record as a GenBank flat file.

downloads.label: GCF_000513755.1
downloads.note: Download the assembly's GenBank file (all records, gzip-compressed); keep it compressed.

downloads.label: Specific color rules
downloads.note: Colors non-ribosomal peptide synthetases, transporters, and transcriptional regulators by product name.

downloads.label: Label priority table
downloads.note: Uses the gene qualifier for CDS labels.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Linear mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and click + Linear before adding the GenBank files.

media.alt: Drawing bar with the Circular and Linear tabs; the Linear drawing tab is selected.
media.caption: After clicking + Linear, the Linear drawing tab is selected.

manualSteps.title: Add the reference genome
manualSteps.body: Download the three files listed under Files. In File 1, click Choose GenBank / DDBJ File and choose NC_009725.2.gbk. This is the reference: the region you select in it is searched for in the other files.

media.alt: The File 1 card with NC_009725.2.gbk chosen.
media.caption: Choose NC_009725.2.gbk in File 1.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const el = document.querySelector('[data-linear-source-card]'); if (!el) throw new Error('Capture target not found: g-file1'); el.dataset.capture = 'g-file1'; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Draw the reference
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. The whole FZB42 chromosome, 3.9 Mb, is one row.

media.alt: The whole B. velezensis FZB42 chromosome NC_009725.2 drawn as one row of CDS arrows.
media.caption: The reference chromosome NC_009725.2 drawn whole.

actions.script: document.querySelector('.preview-feature-search')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.preview-controls')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('.drawer-toggle')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); document.querySelector('footer')?.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const svg = app?.svgContainer?.querySelector('svg'); if (!svg) throw new Error('No generated preview.'); app.resultPanelTab = 'preview'; app.zoom = 1; if (app.canvasPan) { app.canvasPan.x = 0; app.canvasPan.y = 0; } if (app.svgContainer) app.svgContainer.style.setProperty('transform', 'none', 'important'); const width = 1370; const height = width * svg.viewBox.baseVal.height / svg.viewBox.baseVal.width; svg.style.setProperty('width', `${width}px`, 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('height', `${height}px`, 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important'); svg.style.setProperty('max-height', 'none', 'important'); svg.setAttribute('data-capture-tutorial-overview', 'true');

manualSteps.title: Add the other two genomes
manualSteps.body: Click Add sequence and choose NZ_CP011937.1.gbk in File 2. Click Add sequence again and choose GCF_000513755.1_SOAPdenovo_genomic.gbff.gz in File 3. GCF_000513755.1_SOAPdenovo_genomic.gbff.gz is a draft assembly of 74 records: the Choose records dialog opens, and all records stay selected; click Close. The figure does not change until the next Generate.

media.alt: The File 3 card with the draft assembly GCF_000513755.1_SOAPdenovo_genomic.gbff.gz chosen and all its records drawn.
media.caption: Choose the draft assembly GCF_000513755.1_SOAPdenovo_genomic.gbff.gz in File 3; all its records stay selected.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-linear-source-card]')].at(-1); if (!el) throw new Error('Capture target not found: g-file3'); el.dataset.capture = 'g-file3'; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Select the region
manualSteps.body: Below the preview, click Fit so the whole row shows, click Select region, then drag along the reference row from about 1.91 Mb to 1.99 Mb, around the dense cluster of large genes. A popup shows the selected span.

media.alt: The region popup over the FZB42 row with the selected span and the Find in other files button.
media.caption: The popup shows the selected span; Find in other files starts from it.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const el = (() => { document.querySelector('.preview-toolbar')?.style.setProperty('visibility', 'hidden', 'important'); return document.querySelector('[data-preview-item-popup="region"]')?.closest('[role="dialog"]'); })(); if (!el) throw new Error('Capture target not found: g-region'); el.dataset.capture = 'g-region'; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Find the region in the other files
manualSteps.body: In the popup, click Find in other files. Type the exact span in Start and End (39 genes); leave the search settings at their defaults. Click Search; the search runs in the browser and can take a few minutes. The proposal lists one window in CBMB205, reverse complemented, and four contig windows in SK19.001; two contigs that add only one gene each are not selected.

media.alt: Find in other files proposal: one window in NZ_CP011937.1 and four ticked contig windows in the SK19.001 assembly, two contigs not selected.
media.caption: 39 of 39 genes found in each genome: one window in CBMB205, four contigs in SK19.001.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const el = (() => { const overlay = document.querySelector('[data-find-files-dialog]'); overlay?.style.setProperty('background-color', '#fff', 'important'); return overlay?.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); })(); if (!el) throw new Error('Capture target not found: g-proposal'); el.dataset.capture = 'g-proposal'; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Create the new drawing
manualSteps.body: Click Create new drawing. A new drawing tab, Linear 2, opens with one row per File, and Generate Diagram draws it: the reference window, CBMB205's window drawn reverse complemented so it reads like the reference, and the four SK19.001 contigs side by side with circled numbers, bars at contig ends, and pairwise LOSATP ribbons between neighboring rows.

media.alt: Three rows: the FZB42 window, the CBMB205 window, and four SK19.001 contig windows with circled numbers, linked by pairwise ribbons.
media.caption: The new drawing: one row per genome, windows numbered, pairwise ribbons.

manualSteps.title: Group similar proteins
manualSteps.body: In Comparison, click Run LOSAT, open Settings, press LOSATP under LOSAT Mode, and set LOSATP mode to Similarity groups. Click Generate Diagram. Ribbons now link proteins of one similarity group in neighboring rows.

media.alt: The three rows linked by similarity-group ribbons.
media.caption: Similarity groups link one protein family per ribbon.

manualSteps.title: Color the genes by function
manualSteps.body: In Colors, choose cds_grey_default_colors.tsv as the Default colors file (every CDS grey) and bacillus_velezensis_fengycin_specific_colors.tsv as the Specific rules file. Generate Diagram. The five non-ribosomal peptide synthetase genes are red in all three genomes, transporters blue, transcriptional regulators green.

media.alt: The rows with grey CDS arrows, the five non-ribosomal peptide synthetase genes red, transporters blue, transcriptional regulators green.
media.caption: Colors by function: the non-ribosomal peptide synthetase genes stand out in each genome.

manualSteps.title: Name the rows and label the genes
manualSteps.body: In each File card's Record options, type the Organism / strain and Subtitle / title from the table. In Labels, set Show Labels to First record only and choose cds_gene_priority.tsv as the Priority File, so CDS labels show gene names. Generate Diagram.

media.alt: The rows named FZB42, CBMB205 and SK19.001 (draft assembly), with gene names on the FZB42 row.
media.caption: Row names and gene names on the reference row.

colorRules.title: Color by what the records say
colorRules.body: The rules match the product names in the RefSeq records: nonribosomal peptide synthetases red, transporters blue, transcriptional regulators green. Every other CDS stays grey from the Default colors file.

troubleshooting.title: Search stays busy for minutes
troubleshooting.body: Find in other files searches every gene of the region in each other File in the browser. A draft assembly of many records takes longest; keep the tab open until the proposal appears.

troubleshooting.title: A window is missing
troubleshooting.body: Windows that add too few genes are listed under Not selected. Tick one to draw it, or click Edit to change its span.
